name: Weirdcore
garments: not a fashion look — an image aesthetic
reacts_against: polished imagery generally, favoring deliberately unsettling, low-fidelity, text-overlaid photos.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Low-quality digital images, amateur editing, primitive graphics, image compression, distorted or out-of-place objects, unusual borders, word art, uncomfortably framed subjects, liminal spaces, out-of-context captions, incorrect or nonsensical labels, digital artifacts, distorted geometry
wiki_facts.key_values: Confusion, disorientation, dread, alienation, nostalgia (anemoia), dreamlike states, distorted perception, the unfamiliar within the familiar, unease, comfort (paradoxically), curiosity, questioning of reality

findings: dark — about 45% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 85% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
